Payload.$Comment: Keeps every mob Mob Scaling scales in the Shifting Deep's tier 2 (MMO Skill Tree's dungeon Mmo_Shifting_Deep_Tier_2) between level 20 and level 30. Each copy is a world named after the dungeon's file, a dash and the copy's number (mmo_shifting_deep_tier_2-1 and so on), so this pattern reaches tier 2's copies alone. Floor is the level a mob starts at, since a dungeon copy has no zone or biome; MinCap and MaxCap clamp what a nearby group's power makes of it. DistanceEscalation is off and PlayerScalingStartRingBlocks is 0, as in every dungeon band. To move the band, set Floor and MinCap to the new bottom and MaxCap to the new top; add "Enabled": false to switch scaling off in this tier entirely.
